description: Gate-G1 benchmark processes (tools/loop_benchmark): the required-references specification format of tools/loop_reference/required_processes.json (same 'qcd' scheme, loop_sm-no_b_mass), with the 2->2 control, the 2->3/2->4 QCD processes that the v2 generator of work/v2-slice produces, and the seven-leg rows of MASTER_PLAN §5.7 that the WP3.1 generator (work/v2-generation-scale) produces. 'madloop.export' is the MadLoop export built with MG5's production flags, relative to the reference root (--reference-root); 'openloops.unavailable' records why a process has no OpenLoops library. A provider entry with 'matched' could compute the process but has no production-mode timing under HANDOFF §0.1 ('unavailable' gives the reason); 'timing' imports an existing campaign timing (relative to the reference root) instead of running the provider.

qcd.description: QCD corrections in the MG5 loop_sm-no_b_mass model: alpha=1/aEWM1 fixed with Gf and MZ (MW derived at tree level), stable top, massless b/tau/light fermions, all widths zero, five-flavour alpha_s renormalization with decoupled top, six quark flavours in loops, Feynman gauge.
